period: Initial frozen6calendar-month screen May11-Nov11; do not claim maximal historical coverage. Extend only with a separate pre-outcome protocol.
A: At each published funding settlement t: rate>=linear99thpercentile of previous30days excluding current AND previous closed1h C/closed C24h before-1>0 ->SHORT at next full hour
B: rate<=linear1stpercentile previous30days excluding current AND price24h<0 ->LONG next full hour
C: hourly base-unit OI(t)/OI(t-24h)-1>0.30 AND price24h>0.10 ->SHORT next full hour
entry: next full hour after observed funding/OI timestamp; no mark history treated as traded price; require exact next1hopen and all24h subsequent bars
manager: unchangedD14SL1.5ATR14closed1hTR,50/25/25at1/2/3R,BE,24h,5.5bp eachfill,5bp entry/stop/time; stop-first, noTPentrybar; conservative same-bar-newBE lower bound
funding: actual historical settlements; remaining fraction of original base qty; price1hopen proxy, not markprice. If settlement shares exit/partial hour use largest exposure for debit and smallest for credit. Entry-timestamp funding debit included conservatively, credit omitted. No absent funding as0; historical funding publication coverage tracked. Non-crypto contracts with no funding history remain DATA_GAP.
random: mean ofLONG andSHORT on same coin/time/exits, not an executable combined portfolio
always_same_direction: Additional unfiltered SHORT and LONG at every complete eligible settlement time (A/B) and every eligible OI hour(C), same coin/half; same-time same-direction control alone is tautological and not independent.
halves: fixed calendar midpoint; first-half events holding across split removed from both controls using full24h time-only purge; latest24h removed to avoid censoring
screen: EDGE>0 both,t>=2 one,n>=30; ALSO economicmeanRpositiveboth required for promise; no tuning; naive t plus day-cluster t; incomplete history or retrospective universe=>INCONCLUSIVE
